item: 0834/0835: cw8 Phase-1 package, combined verdict on v002 (v001 lenses by helper; v001->v002 delta by lead, RESULT_V002_DELTA 9fa758db)

findings.class: BLOCKING (A115 (a): an honest pinned call refused; custody regression versus cx2v004)
findings.label: TESTED (helper probe on v001) + lead re-verified in v002 bytes
findings.title: The cw8 raw-spec check compares the whole spec dict, path included, and refuses honest S0-kit relaunch history
findings.evidence: v002 phase1_ngc_launch_cx3cw8v002.py L3401: need(record.get('spec', call['spec']) == call['spec'], 'CW8_ATTEMPT_RAW_SPEC'). It is called for every record, KIT origin included, in history (L1698), close_attempt (L1882) and verify_closed_receipt (L2894). For a KIT call, call['spec'] = entry['spec'], the kit registry entry (L1012). On a kit relaunch, s0_kit_c2v003a cmd_register keeps the existing entry when the spec sha matches (ALREADY_REGISTERED_SAME_SPEC, L636-644). But every serial invocation fills into a fresh $WORK/fill (launch_s0_serial_root_c2v003a.sh L138-141), and the launch record carries that new path (kit L1130). So identical bytes come with a different path. Helper probe (v001; the same line is in v002): base cx2v004 close_attempt gives FINISHED and accepts the attempt, the cw8 successor refuses CW8_ATTEMPT_RAW_SPEC, and with an identical path both accept.
findings.effect: After any kit relaunch (its own MISLAUNCH relaunch or the D7 relaunch after a monitor refusal, A223 G25), that S0 serial call cannot be closed, rerun or assembled into the Phase-1 registry by the single Phase-1/2 launcher (0835). The twin is unaffected: its fill dir comes from the seed registry.
findings.fix: Compare the spec sha256 only, record['spec']['sha256'] == call['spec']['sha256']. Serial and cw8 specs differ in sha, so the raw-spec discrimination still holds (old_raw_spec_receipt_refuses). Add a kit-relaunch-path test.
